_comment: fMRI datasets: ADNI, HCP rest and working memory, sleep wake and N3; linear_hopf model only. Paths accept $ENV_VARS; $DATA_DIR is set in .env.

ADNI_Schaefer400._comment: fMRI, already band-passed in preprocessing: band null. One 197-TR epoch per subject (split in time for split-half).
ADNI_Schaefer400._freqs_path: Hopf node frequencies: python scripts/compute_node_freqs.py configs/fmri.json ADNI_Schaefer400

HCP_RESTLR._comment: HCP fMRI, one run per subject. Not band-passed when stored: band bold (0.008-0.08 Hz, as the lab's HCP pipeline). sc_path: check that the SC has the same node order as the time series.
HCP_RESTLR._freqs_path: Hopf node frequencies: python scripts/compute_node_freqs.py configs/fmri.json HCP_RESTLR

HCP_WMLR._comment: HCP fMRI, one run per subject. Not band-passed when stored: band bold (0.008-0.08 Hz, as the lab's HCP pipeline). sc_path: check that the SC has the same node order as the time series.
HCP_WMLR._freqs_path: Shares the rest frequencies of HCP_RESTLR

Sleep_W._comment: Sleep fMRI (wake / N3), one run per subject. Not band-passed when stored: band bold (0.008-0.08 Hz, as the lab's HCP pipeline). sc_path: group SC of DataSleepW_N3.mat, same node order as the time series.
Sleep_W._freqs_path: Hopf node frequencies: python scripts/compute_node_freqs.py configs/fmri.json Sleep_W

Sleep_N3._comment: Sleep fMRI (wake / N3), one run per subject. Not band-passed when stored: band bold (0.008-0.08 Hz, as the lab's HCP pipeline). sc_path: group SC of DataSleepW_N3.mat, same node order as the time series.
Sleep_N3._freqs_path: Hopf node frequencies: python scripts/compute_node_freqs.py configs/fmri.json Sleep_N3

_bands: bold: the BOLD band of the lab's HCP pipeline, 2nd-order Butterworth applied forward and backward (sosfiltfilt), as theirs. A band is [f_low, f_high] (4th order, as the EEG / MEG bands) or {hz, order}.

linear_hopf._comment: freqs_path is set per dataset (datasets block). fs_norm zerolag, as the empirical FS: with the legacy 'lagged' normalisation FS_ii ~ cos(2 pi f tau) turns negative for f > 1 / (4 tau), ~0.042 Hz at ADNI's tau (6 s), inside the fMRI band, and the fit fails.
linear_hopf._coupling_norm: max: as neuronumba, max(C) = maxC. 'diag' reproduces the earlier fits (legacy normalisation, max row sum = maxC, ~11x weaker coupling for AAL90). Set explicitly: it is part of the fit folder name.

_fitting: check_every 100, as neuronumba's FitGEC: tol is the relative improvement between two checks, so checking every 10 iterations stops ~10x earlier, and any increase between checks (one noisy step) stops the fit.
_fdt_metrics: FDT measures of the downstream step and Study 3: 'integral' (fdt_eeg's analytic integral violation, key fdt) and / or 'onsager' (Deco's Onsager formalism, key fdt_onsager) and / or 'ivfdt' (the lab's updated HCP pipeline: stationary variance-normalised I_tot, key fdt_ivfdt, and rho_brk). A measure added later is computed into the existing downstream files, the others are kept.
_study3: lab_default: the lab's default learning rates per model, outlined in the Study 3 figures (must be a cell of the eps_fc x eps_fs grid; null: not shown).

sweep._comment: Study 2: fix eps_fc, vary eps_fs (and the reverse)

Updated fit (config.PROCEDURES 'updated': weighted step, FC + FS_A stopping rule): the Study 2 grid. Studies 2 and 3 show it as a model of its own (linear_hopf_updated); Study 4 compares it with the original fit.
